title: Add Anime Forge to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Anime Forge](https://animeforge-k4ltm64.public.builtwithrocket.new) to image
- Anime Forge is an AI-driven anime character design web app powered by Pollinations API for text and image generation.

Fixes #12773

gist.headline: Fresh anime pollen
gist.blurb: Anime Forge joined the garden: a web app for designing anime characters with Pollinations text and image generation. More character sheets, fewer blank-canvas stares.
gist.summary: Added Anime Forge to the community app listings, highlighting its Pollinations-powered AI workflow for designing anime characters with text and image generation.
gist.impact: People exploring Pollinations apps can now discover Anime Forge as a ready-made tool for creating original anime character concepts.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Anime Forge as a cozy character-design studio: a retro terminal displays a simple anime character portrait and sketch sheets while Polli helps arrange glowing pixel art tools. Polli wears a tiny artist beret and holds a pencil, surrounded by code-plants, pastel flowers, and an Anime Forge sign; the scene represents turning prompts into character ideas.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene inside a warm anime character-design studio, with a retro CRT computer showing a cute original anime character portrait and simple pixel-font text reading "ANIME FORGE". The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny painter's beret and happily sketches beside glowing lime green (#ecf874) code-plants, pastel flowers, and character sheets. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
